content: The industry consent bar for apps sending user text to a third-party LLM (codified by Apple App Store guideline 5.1.2(i), 2025-2026) is: contextual in-app disclosure, not a privacy-policy line; the AI provider named explicitly; a specific statement of what data is transmitted and why; and explicit opt-in. Common desktop pattern: AI features off by default behind a settings toggle whose screen carries the full disclosure, with flipping the toggle constituting consent.
